# @appolabs/appo

> The Appo CLI: turn a website into native iOS and Android apps and publish them on the App Store and Google Play, from the terminal or an agent.

A thin, dependency-free Node client over the Appo public API (`/api/v1`) and the
RFC 8628 device-authorization grant. Run the complete Appo app lifecycle —
create, ship, publish, push — from a shell or an agent. Two canonical commands:
`appo new` (the app on your phone) and `appo ship` (the app on the stores).
An AI agent can run the CLI or use the remote MCP connector,
`https://apps.goappo.io/mcp`, which `appo mcp` registers.
